verdict.rationale: The evidence describes CLI commands, rule-based scanning, AI-powered detection, Assistant post-processing of findings, and an MCP server. None of it documents operating Semgrep itself through natural-language commands. AI triage and detection are adjacent features, and the MCP server belongs to a separate story, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
